name: – Andreas Schieder – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Albania
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on Albania's progress towards joining the EU. It praises Albania for opening all negotiation chapters in just over a year and for supporting EU foreign policy. It asks Albania to do more on fighting corruption, protecting journalists, reforming elections, and protecting the environment. It also calls on the EU to keep supporting Albania financially and to explain the benefits of enlargement to citizens. The report is an opinion; it does not change any laws.

- Albania is praised for fast EU talks but pressed to deliver real reforms, not just laws.
- Albanian politicians, judges, journalists and civil society are directly affected by these demands.
- Next, EU institutions and Albania's government are asked to act on these recommendations.
